title: 第七章 组队
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
出了职业大厅，林铮洞，最后的精铁矿说是可以找玩家收购，总的来说这个任务难度不算太大吧，就是可能得花多点时间了。
清风森林，地图介绍是适合10-30级的玩家练级，由于怪物分布密度比较大，所以建议玩家组队前往。于是在清风森林外围就出现了很多玩家寻求队员的热闹场景！当然，部分艺高人胆大的玩家是选择了单刷，如杨琪这一流，在清风森林单刷对她来说是毫无压力！
“铁板甲士求组！缺盾的加！”一个刚出新手村的战士如是喊道，不过他那一身新手装让人对他的防御和血量实在没信心，喊半天愣是没人加！
“强力奶妈！奶水充足!!”一牧师mm刚刚喊出来，马上就有队伍抢着邀请，可见，牧师，尤其是牧师mm，那是抢手货！是每个游戏不可或缺的职业啊！
此外，强力的dps成员也是很抢手的，神箭手，魔法师，此类玩家大受追捧，而陷阱猎人就比较苦逼了，这是个对boss和pk职业，要说练级还真没什么出色的地方，没输出没防御，看那些陷阱猎人们喊破喉咙都没几个加的，阶级社会啊！倒是斗剑士这个职业，还是比较受欢迎的，血防比较中庸，好歹不算脆皮，关键是输出不错，有两个群攻技能呢!所以，林铮一出现在森林外围，马上又不少人来邀请他加队。
林铮现在主要想的是完成任务，组队的话任务肯定会比较快完成的，毕竟人多杀的怪也多，掉落任务物品的机会也就多了。不过，不是每个队伍都是去杀独角蜥蜴的，所以林铮喊了起来：“强力斗剑士一枚，求组杀独角蜥蜴！有要的拉走！”
刚一喊出，一个甲士就走到了林铮跟前，对林铮道：“兄弟，我们就是去杀蜥蜴的，刚好缺个输出，来不！？”
林铮看了一下这个甲士，乖乖！这块头，一米八几，浑身肌肉，他不当甲士谁当甲士啊！这个块头，估计队友会很有安全感吧！看他一脸忠厚老实的样，林铮心里也感觉比较妥帖，于是点头答应了。“玩家霸王重甲邀请你进入队伍，是否接受申请？”点击接受，随着一声剑鸣的提示音，林铮进入队伍了，同时队伍成员的信息也呈窗口弹了出来，五个人，加上他刚好就六个人了。
“欢迎加入我们的队伍，我带你去见其他人！叫我霸王就可以了！”霸王重甲咧嘴笑道，林铮含笑回应，然后便跟着他向森林走去。走了没一会儿，两人便见到其他队友了。
“你们好啊！我是一平道人，斗剑士！”林铮微笑着自我介绍道。
“你好！我叫龙龙龙龙牙！叫我龙牙就行了，魔法师！”这个名字取的，不知道的在他念出来的时候还以为这家伙是个结巴，林铮看着眼前这个活力十足的魔法师，立刻就给他打上了标签！M属性的！这家伙绝对是个M属性的！
“我叫蒂法，神箭手！”蒂法！？看着眼前英姿飒爽的女孩，林铮惊讶地发现，这女孩与最终幻想里面那个还真像！无论是外表还是神情，神似到了极点！软妹子啊！长得还真是可爱啊！再看旁边，林铮顿时有些呆滞，谁家的小女孩啊！就这个子，还没13岁吧！不是说这游戏只有年龄18以上的人才可以玩的吗？
“那个，不是说这游戏是18周岁才能玩的吗？！这个小妹妹是怎么进来的啊？！”林铮指了下小萝莉到。
这不说话还好，一说话便点炸了小萝莉！只见小萝莉额上青筋一跳，张口便朝林铮的手指咬了下去！
“啊——”毫无意外的一声惨叫响起！
小萝莉把脸一鼓，气呼呼地接着给了了林铮一脚，“你才是小妹妹！你全家都是小妹妹！我已经18岁了！我是大学生！我已经成年了！我不是小孩！看吧！我能进来这个游戏就是最好的证明！你们说是不是！都说了是不是！？”
“是！是！我家小喵已经长大了，乖！乖！”蒂法含笑着把小萝莉搂在怀里道，小萝莉一脸埋在蒂法胸前，很是开心地笑了！
果然很好哄！还是个小孩啊！林铮吹着手指想着，不对，应该说果然是个小孩啊！
“我叫几度春风，侠客，随便怎么叫，疯子春风都行！！”最后的的队友一脸和善地对林铮笑道，“小喵就这样，你别介意！”

content_en:
After leaving the occupation hall and Linzheng Cave, the last refined iron ore can be purchased from players. Generally speaking, this task is not too difficult, but it may take a little more time.
Qingfeng Forest, the map introduction is suitable for players of levels 10-30 to level up. Due to the relatively high distribution density of monsters, it is recommended that players form a team to go there. So there were many lively scenes outside Qingfeng Forest with many players looking for team members! Of course, some brave players with advanced skills choose to play alone. For a class like Yang Qi, there is no pressure for her to play alone in Qingfeng Forest!
"Iron plate warriors, please join! If you are short of shields, add them!" shouted a warrior who had just left the novice village. However, his novice uniform made people have no confidence in his defense and blood volume. After shouting for a long time, no one added him!
"Powerful nanny! Plenty of milk!!" A pastor sister just shouted, and immediately there were teams rushing to invite her. It can be seen that pastors, especially pastor sisters, are hot commodities! It is an indispensable profession in every game!
In addition, powerful DPS members are also in high demand. Players like archers and magicians are very popular, but trap hunters are more difficult. This is a profession that targets bosses and PKs. When it comes to leveling, there is really nothing outstanding about it. There is no output and no defense. Look at those trap hunters who scream and scream, but few of them can level up. What a class society! On the other hand, the profession of swordfighter is still relatively popular. The blood defense is relatively average, and it is not squishy at all. The key is that the output is good and it has two group attack skills! Therefore, as soon as Lin Zheng appeared outside the forest, many people immediately came to invite him to join the team.
Lin Zheng's main concern now is to complete the mission. If he forms a team, the mission will definitely be completed faster. After all, more people will kill more monsters, and there will be more chances of dropping mission items. However, not every team is going to kill the one-horned lizard, so Lin Zheng shouted: "A powerful swordsman, please join the team to kill the one-horned lizard! Take away those who want it!"
As soon as he shouted, a soldier walked up to Lin Zheng and said to Lin Zheng: "Brother, we are just going to kill the lizards. We happen to be short of an output, are you coming!?"
Lin Zheng looked at the soldier and said, "Good boy!" This guy is about 1.8 meters tall and has muscles all over his body. Who can be a soldier if he is not a soldier? With this size, my teammates will probably feel very safe! Seeing the honest and honest look on his face, Lin Zheng felt more comfortable in his heart, so he nodded in agreement. "Player Overlord Heavy Armor invites you to join the team. Do you accept the application?" Click to accept, and with the sound of a sword, Lin Zheng entered the team. At the same time, the information of the team members also popped up in the window. There were five people, and he made exactly six people.
"Welcome to our team, I will take you to meet the others! Just call me Overlord!" Overlord Heavy Armor grinned. Lin Zheng responded with a smile, and then followed him towards the forest. After walking for a while, the two met other teammates.
"Hello! I am Yiping Taoist, a swordsman!" Lin Zheng introduced himself with a smile.
"Hello! My name is Longlonglonglongya! Just call me Longya, magician!" He came up with this name, and when he read it out, he thought this guy was a stutterer. Lin Zheng looked at the energetic magician in front of him and immediately labeled him! M attribute! This guy definitely has M attributes!
"My name is Tifa, the Archer!" Tifa! ? Looking at the heroic girl in front of him, Lin Zheng was surprised to find that this girl looked exactly like the one in Final Fantasy! No matter the appearance or expression, they are extremely similar! Soft girl! She looks really cute! Looking next to him, Lin Zheng suddenly became a little stunned. Whose little girl is this? This kid is not even 13 years old! Didn’t it say that this game can only be played by people over the age of 18?
"Well, didn't it say that this game can only be played by 18 years old?! How did this little girl get in?Yes? ! "Lin Zheng pointed at the little Lolita.
It's okay if you don't speak, but if you speak, the little loli will explode! I saw a vein on the little Loli's forehead twitching, she opened her mouth and bit Lin Zheng's finger!
"Ah——" A scream sounded out without any surprise!
The little Loli puffed up her face and angrily kicked Lin Zheng, "You are the little sister! Your whole family is a little sister! I'm already 18 years old! I'm a college student! I'm an adult! I'm not a child! Look! My ability to enter this game is the best proof! Do you think so? You’ve said it all, haven’t you? ? "
"yes! yes! My little cat has grown up, be good! good! "Tifa said with a smile, holding the little Loli in her arms. The little Loli buried her face in Tifa's chest and smiled happily!
It’s really easy to coax! Still a child! Lin Zheng blew his fingers and thought, no, it should be said that he is really a child!
"My name is Jidu Chunfeng, knight, whatever you want, crazy spring breeze! ! "The last teammate smiled kindly at Lin Zheng and said, "That's it, little meow, don't mind! "
